mapper.select: SELECT t.tenant_id,t.id FROM task t LEFT JOIN actor_access a ON a.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND a.actor_id=t.owner_actor_id LEFT JOIN installation i ON i.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND i.plugin_id='ask_user_question' WHERE t.question_binding IS NOT NULL AND t.state IN ('WAITING_USER','RESUME_READY') AND (#{enabled}=FALSE OR t.deadline<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR t.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL OR a.enabled=FALSE OR i.plugin_id IS NULL OR i.enabled=FALSE OR i.epoch<>t.installation_epoch OR i.plugin_version<>JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.tools_snapshot,'$.pins.ask_user_question.version')) OR i.plugin_digest<>JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.tools_snapshot,'$.pins.ask_user_question.digest')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_question q WHERE q.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND q.task_id=t.id AND q.phase='OPEN' AND q.foreground_due_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) ORDER BY t.deadline,t.id LIMIT 64
SELECT * FROM user_question WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND phase='OPEN' AND foreground_due_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FOR UPDATE
